registered_before_data: Approved by the user on 2026-11-19 before any v3 event, return or statistic was computed. Inputs inspected beforehand: the entitlement probe, the acceptance-time checks and the v2 audit-only blocker report (no returns).
relation_to_v2: insider-event-v2 stays registered and unchanged. v3 rescopes it to data that exists and can be verified; every recipe field below marked 'as v2' is copied verbatim from prereg/insider_event_v2.json.
why_rescoped: v2's coverage gate (historical_data.coverage_check) requires S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and Russell 2000 membership from 2006 with source attestations; only S&P 500 from 2015-12-31 exists (ledger_local/insider_v2_recheck_20261119).

No vendor-archive quarterly estimates are available: LSEG estimates content returns 403 (missing scope trapi.data.est.sum), Datastream is not reachable from the session, and calc-date history is restated for later splits (ledger_local/estimate_entitlement_probe_20261119.json).
decided_before_results: The estimate-control choice below follows the rule fixed in the approved plan (vendor archive found -> primary control; none found -> no primary control, calc-date estimates as labelled sensitivity). The probe found none.
execution: as v2: First regular open on a later New York date. Compare beta-adjusted five-session returns on the same calendar. Rank by score within an entry session and enforce the same position cap across variants.
cost_sensitivities: fixed fills at twice order size
fixed fills at twice execution cost
historical_evidence: as v2: Development only. All historical dates are treated as potentially viewed.
forward_review: as v2: At least 90 calendar days and 100 settled scored events, complete required inputs, positive after-cost performance versus both baselines and user review. Research output never grants trading authority.

scope.universe: Securities that are S&P 500 members on the event date per membership.parquet of bundle data/raw/historical/8433bd236228ba351c9a (LSEG, month-end resolution, disclosed).
scope.window: Entry dates 2016-01-04 to 2026-10-30 (bundle span). Beta and liquidity windows may use earlier bundle prices.
scope.coverage_gate: S&P-only audit (ridge_sp500_study.audit_bundle checks): coverage span, benchmark sessions vs an independent exchange schedule, independent roster reconciliation, per-member price gaps and terminal outcomes. The five source attestations (constituents_complete, identifiers_verified, delisted_prices_complete, terminal_events_complete, corporate_actions_verified) are reported as unattested limitations on every output; the study status cannot be VALIDATED while any is false.
scope.price_gaps: An event is excluded if any session from entry to exit for that security is missing from bundle prices; exclusions are counted and listed. Current audit: 2 members without prices (HST_HSTN, KMB_KMBN) and 7 with gaps (ARNC_20230818, BIIB, BKR_BKRN, CPB_CPBN, DD, FITB, FTI).
scope.acceptance_times: Primary sample: Form 4 events with an exact EDGAR acceptance time in data/processed/insider_acceptances.csv. Events without one (currently 4 accessions absent from the EDGAR archive, ledger_local/form4_index_resolved_20261119.json) are excluded. Date-only results are reported separately as a sensitivity.
scope.estimate_control: None in the primary specification. Calc-date FQ1 consensus history (data/processed/estimate_vintages_sensitivity.parquet, timestamp_basis inferred_calc_date) is used only in a labelled sensitivity.
scope.concurrent_events: Primary sample excludes events whose entry-to-exit window, extended 2 sessions before entry, contains an 8-K available_date with item 2.02 (results of operations), 1.01 (material agreement) or 2.01 (completed acquisition/disposition), from data/processed/8k_items.parquet after the 2026-11-19 acceptance-time correction (data_8k.accepted_et). A sensitivity includes them.
scope.costs: Cost model v2_quoted (config.COST_MODEL; prereg/spread_check_v1.json): FX 0.15% + max(quoted 60-session half-spread, 3 bp) + square-root impact at the order size, plus SLIPPAGE 5 bp per side as in insider_study.StudyMarket.

known_limitations: S&P 500 only, 2016-2026; membership at month-end resolution.
Five source attestations unverified; status stays below VALIDATED until they are.
No point-in-time quarterly estimate control in the primary result.
Holdout-style historical evidence is development only; promotion requires the forward record.
